## Sprint 11 active coordination — 2026-09-22

The canonical roster remains exactly #916 through #925. Acceptance remains serial in numeric order; preparation overlap does not satisfy a predecessor gate.

Current authorized work:

- #915: Planning #7.3 is recording the operator-approved incomplete/deferred Sprint 10 outcome. Planning #11 owns #936 accounting closeout. This disposition preserves unmet qualification claims.
- #916: Planning #11 owns the quality decision; Worker #9 supplies read-only producer-acceptance audit support. The overall decision remains `not_proven`; current audit work does not establish PASS.
- #917: Planning #4.5 owns documentation-handoff preparation. Final TAIL-02 acceptance still requires accepted #916 output.
- #918: Worker #10 owns publication-package preparation. Its reported 122/122 inventory match is preparation evidence; final identity and accepted #917 output remain required.
- #922: Planning #11 owns successor-mapping preparation. Final TAIL-07 acceptance still requires accepted #921 output.
- #919-#921 and #923-#925 remain dependency-gated. #925 also requires accepted #910 and #911 outputs and exact human release authority.

The incomplete Sprint 10 obligations are routed into v0.93 as #1148 (citation correctness), #1149 (interrupted-request recovery), and #1150 (independent qualification after accepted #1148/#1149). Those issues do not authorize v0.93 execution, Beta 1 launch, release, provider calls, deployment, publication, or merge.

The next safe independent lane is #922 mapping preparation only. The tracked Sprint Execution Packet records the owner map, exact gates, non-claims, and active preparation wave.
